description: Refund requests with the shop's policy stated in the text.

not_key.instructions: The refund should not be issued

s2.instructions: The customer has proof of purchase

s3.instructions: The request is within the return window

cases.state: Policy: refunds within 30 days with a receipt. A customer bought headphones 12 days ago, attached the receipt, and says they stopped charging.
Policy: refunds within 30 days with a receipt. A customer bought headphones 45 days ago, attached the receipt, and says they stopped charging.
Policy: refunds within 30 days with a receipt. A customer wants money back for a blender bought last week but says they threw the receipt away and has no order number.
Policy: refunds within 30 days with a receipt. A customer wants money back for a blender bought last week and forwards the e-receipt from their email.
Policy: refunds within 30 days with a receipt. The customer writes: 'I don't need a refund, just tell me how to clean the filter.' They bought the vacuum 10 days ago, receipt attached.
Policy: refunds within 30 days with a receipt. The vacuum bought 10 days ago arrived with a cracked filter housing; the customer asks for a refund and attaches the receipt.
